verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an LLM gateway and observability SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence shows logs can be viewed in the dashboard and shared via unique URLs, and that the gateway is open source, but nothing documents exporting logs, prompts, configs or other account data in open formats. Shareable log links and a self-hostable gateway are adjacent features, not a data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
